title: 空间站停靠费按时间累积，玩家未意识到导致损失。
description: 空间站停靠费按时间累积，玩家未意识到导致损失。
evidence: Didn't realize spaceport docking fees rack up based on time spent in dock, had my guy repairing my ship while I was off getting something to eat, docking fees ended up being 13000 dollars (i had 43 after paying my ships mortgage) so I lost the run.

evidence_items.quote: Didn't realize spaceport docking fees rack up based on time spent in dock, had my guy repairing my ship while I was off getting something to eat, docking fees ended up being 13000 dollars (i had 43 after paying my ships mortgage) so I lost the run.
evidence_items.description: 空间站停靠费按时间累积，玩家未意识到导致损失。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没意识到太空港的停靠费会根据在港停留的时间累积，我让我的家伙在我出去弄点吃的时候修理我的船，停靠费最后变成了13000美元（付完我的船贷后我只有43块），所以我输掉了这一局。
